title: Local Leaders Celebrate the Grand Opening of a 95-Unit Affordable Housing Development for Seniors
description:
SAN DIEGO – Chelsea Investment Corporation, County Supervisor Monica Montgomery-Steppe, San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria, and Councilmember Dr. Jennifer Campbell gathered to celebrate the grand opening of Terrasini, a 95-unit affordable housing development for individuals aged 62+.
Older adults are the fastest-growing population experiencing homelessness in San Diego, often due to job loss or serious illness. They struggle to afford rent on monthly incomes as low as $1,200 and often have to choose between food and medicine. Terrasini will change the quality of life for 95 San Diego seniors who struggle to find a safe and affordable place to call home.
